high_level_description: This image is a comic strip featuring three panels, created by the artist Ashley Bobaxter, as indicated at the bottom of the third panel. Panel 1: The first panel shows a woman with red lips and dark hair, speaking to a skull. She says, "I'M PRETTY WEIRD." The skull responds with, "I KNOW. I LOVE IT." Panel 2: This panel is a close-up of the skull's face, emphasizing its detailed features such as the teeth and eye sockets. The background is dark, focusing attention on the skull
